page.summary:
I fixed all seven items of the third review's default-sources findings in reader/zone.html of tree pt (branch toggles-fixes). For each fix I ran the reviewer's case on the live page (8914) before and on the tree (8921) after. Every fix that changes behavior has a check that fails on live and passes on the tree, except the wording and ink nits, which have probe proof only. Two commits: 4c7edc00f3 (the page fixes, the D7 model in check-default-picks-v1 and the new check-rulings-under-sources-v1) and daa33c2785 (three checks that hold the fixes: check-names-gate-v1 N9, check-form-of-v1 F12, check-menu-switches-v1 M2). The page lint is at its baseline and every tool I changed lints clean.

All the listed checks pass on the tree with two exceptions:
- **D20 in check-default-picks-v1** fails because the receipt on disk is still the one from main 46bbbf7d50. The tools builder's notes say it passes once the receipt is baked again, and that bake is the lead's step.
- **check-line-reads-the-place-v1 P3 on Ruth** fails the same way on live, so it was there before these changes. It passes on Amos, the default book.

Readiness contract, for the tools builder (they made their two checks hold it in ec22497676): window.__default.ready is true once every line stands as the sources in force draw it.
- At rest on STEP, or with no source in force (another reads order, or a book the index does not list), it is true at once.
- Under MACULA, UBS or BDB it turns true once that source's book file has loaded.
- failed is true when the file could not be fetched; every line is then the line as it rests.
- A card that asks for the file at rest does not make ready false. Checks can wait on `!d || d.ready || d.failed` and will not run out their 30 s at rest.

Reset timing with every section built: Psalms went from 57.1 s on live to 20.5 s, and II Samuel from 13.5 s to 9.6 s. As loaded (only the first sections built) the reset takes 0.4–0.7 s on both. What remains is the source switch's own repaint (completeness critic N3), which I did not change. Notes are in /home/user/mashiachsonyosef.github.io/wip/2026-11-15/the-toggles-fixes/page/RUNNING-NOTES.md, and probes and logs are under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/v73/page/.

tools.summary:
All three parts of the tools brief are fixed and committed on toggles-fixes in scratch pt, in three commits. Nothing in zone.html was touched. Each fix was shown red before and green after, except the reworded sentences (prose, so no check can be red or green on them).

1. The gate's S1 now builds and reads every sampled chapter whole (commit 3757d0b30d). On a fault I made (Amos 5:27:5 changed in a copy of amos.bin served on 8961), HEAD's S1 was green and the new S1 is red. On the tree it is green. Two books took 160 s against 148 s before.

2. The default picks' receipt and its check (commit 05f65ef014).
   - STEP's cells now count where its words actually print: 232 pills, made 232 (they said 1,015, made 65).
   - «made» now counts a pill the card makes, measured against the store under the keys the card looks up.
   - A new law, D20, holds these counts. It is red on HEAD's receipt and green on the receipt the new bake writes.
   - The «counts in no fill» sentences now say what the index does.
   - The check's model of STEP's words has the sign rule, from a single copy in gloss-store-v1.mjs that the bake and the check both import.
   - D5's side line is now a law over all 39 records: red with the old model at 38 places, green with the sign rule.
   - The fault harness has three new faults, H11–H13; all go red as they should.
   - The pin names the letters of v180, v180.1 and v195; a new D1 (d) clause is red on HEAD's pin and green after.
   - On the round: I moved the receipt's writing rather than changing what the bake reads. The bake still runs before the gate and the lines step, which need the index. It runs again after the lines step with a new `--receipt-only` flag. That keeps one rule in one place (the bake), run twice. That second pass refuses if the re-read records would change the index.

3. The two checks' waits (commit ec22497676). The page builder's commit 4c7edc00f3 sets the contract: the page says it is ready at once at rest, and under another source once its book file is loaded. Both checks now treat a page that does not say so within 30 s as a failure rather than waiting it out.
   - check-card-opens-on-the-line-v1: 1,522 s before (HEAD's check on the live page), 309 s after (on the tree's page). Both green.
   - check-ruled-equals-first-paint-v1: red on the live page (the page never says ready at rest), green on the tree.

The receipt itself is a generated file and is not committed. D20 stays red on the tree until the round (or the bake with `--receipt-only`) rewrites it.

My first picks commit had swept in the page builder's uncommitted D7 changes to check-default-picks-v1.mjs. I amended it to carry my changes only; they have since committed their part (4c7edc00f3).

Notes are in /home/user/mashiachsonyosef.github.io/wip/2026-11-15/the-toggles-fixes/tools/RUNNING-NOTES.md. Logs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/v73/tools/logs/.
